title: 信息日报 2026-08-09

headline.title: Claude Code 将 Auto 模式设为 Pro、Max 和 Team 计划默认
headline.summary: Anthropic 宣布自 8 月 14 日起，Claude Code 在 Pro、Max 和 Team 计划中默认启用 Auto 模式。该模式允许 AI 自主执行多步骤任务，减少人工审批，显示 Anthropic 对 AI 代理编码能力的高度信心。这一变化将显著提升开发者效率，并推动 AI 编程自动化进入主流。
headline.title_en: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans
headline.summary_en: Anthropic will make Auto mode the default for new sessions in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans starting August 14. The mode lets the AI autonomously complete multi-step tasks with reduced human approval, signaling strong confidence in its AI coding agent. The change is set to boost developer productivity and mainstream autonomous AI programming.
headline.original_title: Auto mode is now the default in Claude Code for Pro, Max, and Team plans
headline.reason: 该消息涉及主流 AI 编程工具的重大默认设置变更，影响广泛开发者，且为今日开发者社区聚焦点，评分最高。
headline.reason_en: This news represents a major default-setting change in a mainstream AI coding tool, affecting a wide range of developers and drawing significant attention in the developer community, with the highest score.
